title: CFCFBFBEE CAIF BJBGBFCABCJHICA
about: A collection of the moments that made State Arts-In feel like State Arts-In: traditions, friendships, backstage stories, ridiculous jokes, and the little experiences that became part of life together at the fair.
body: CFCFBFBEE CAIF BJBGBFCABCJHICA is about the kind of memories that weren't defined by one production or one big event. They were the things that happened around State Arts-In: at meals, backstage, during the show, while spending time together, and in all the spaces between what we were actually supposed to be doing.

There were traditions like table chants and building breakfast towers, moments onstage and backstage that became their own stories, and jokes that could take on a life of their own simply because we were together long enough for something ridiculous to become normal.

Some memories came from being part of the production, like operating the trapdoor during Nick's solo or turning a tiny pirate ship into its own little performance. Others came entirely from the people, like discovering just how quiet someone can become when you scare them badly enough.

None of these needed to be the defining story of a year to matter. They're the smaller stories, traditions, friendships, and bits of chaos that filled the days between the big moments and made State Arts-In a place I wanted to keep coming back to.
